DUSTEE can push forward and could prove hard to run down. CHICA ASTUTA is better than her first-up effort suggests. Expect to see her improve. AZYTASS was runner-up to the topweight last time. raceTips.comment: Just fair speed in the small field. PRETTY BABY was suited by the tempo last start but did still record a commanding win. CHICA ASTUTA was awful first up - she may not have handled the track? Her best can win but not sure what she delivers. AZYTASS is an honest on-pacer.
